name: Shadcn Number Scrubber
summary: Draggable numeric input for React that adjusts its value by dragging horizontally, styled for shadcn/ui.
description: A numeric input component for React built with shadcn/ui, inspired by the scrubbable number fields of desktop video editors like DaVinci Resolve. Dragging horizontally changes the value with configurable sensitivity, min/max bounds and step sizes; it is fully typed with TypeScript and follows shadcn/ui styling conventions. Installs with the shadcn CLI and requires the shadcn Input component.
contains: draggable numeric input, inspired by video editing software
min/max bounds and customizable step sizes
shadcn CLI install; requires TypeScript and the shadcn Input component
